script: セイバールート十二日目-06
title: セイバールート十二日目-06

pages.ja:
「だめでござる。今日は断食するでござる」
兵糧既に尽き背水の河氾濫せり。
シークタイムゼロ、脊髄反射で返答したよ。
pages.jaRuby:
「だめでござる。今日は断食するでござる」
兵糧既に尽き背水の河氾濫せり。
シークタイムゼロ、脊髄反射で返答したよ。
pages.en:
“Nay, milady. Today, we fast.”

Our provisions exhausted, the river at our backs is on the verge of bursting its banks.

Seek time: zero. My spinal cord answered before the question reached my brain.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“No can do. We’re fasting today.”
Provisions exhausted, ready for my last stand.
Seek time
zero,
zero seconds,
I reply on reflex.

pages.ja: 「シロウ……？ その、今のはどのような意味なのでしょう……？」
pages.jaRuby: 「シロウ……？ その、今のはどのような意味なのでしょう……？」
pages.en: “Shirou…? What, precisely, did you mean by that…?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Shirou…? What does that mean…?”

pages.ja:
「分かりにくかったか。
今のは、今日は昼飯抜きだって意思表示。朝はハンバーグだったし、昼抜いてもいいかなって」
pages.jaRuby:
「分かりにくかったか。
今のは、今日は昼飯抜きだって意思表示。朝はハンバーグだったし、昼抜いてもいいかなって」
pages.en:
“Was I unclear?

“I was declaring that we'll skip lunch. We had hamburger steaks for breakfast, so I thought we could go without it today.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Is it hard for you to understand?
I’m telling you that we’re not eating lunch today. We had hamburgers for breakfast, so I thought we could skip lunch.”

pages.ja:
どうしてそんな気分になったのかは俺にも判らないが、まあ、あんまりハラ減ってないし。
せっかくセイバーと竹刀を合わせるんだから、もう少し鍛練を続けたいし。
pages.jaRuby:
どうしてそんな気分になったのかは俺にも判らないが、まあ、あんまりハラ減ってないし。
せっかくセイバーと竹刀を合わせるんだから、もう少し鍛練を続けたいし。
pages.en:
I do not understand what inspired the decision myself, but I am not especially hungry.

And since I have the opportunity to cross swords with Saber, I would like to train a little longer.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I don’t know why I felt that way, but well, I’m not that hungry right now anyway.
We’re in the middle of the training, so I want to continue.

pages.ja:
「そんな訳で試合を続けよう。ほら、竹刀構えてくれセイバー」
竹刀の切っ先をセイバーに向ける。
pages.jaRuby:
「そんな訳で試合を続けよう。ほら、竹刀構えてくれセイバー」
竹刀の切っ先をセイバーに向ける。
pages.en:
“So let's continue. Come on, Saber. Raise your shinai.”

I point the bamboo sword toward her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“So let’s continue with the training. Come on, put your shinai up.”
I point my shinai at Saber.

pages.ja:
「ま、待ってくださいシロウ、話はまったく、一手たりとも進んでいません！
朝食を十分に摂ったから昼食はいらない、というのはあまりに浅慮ではありませんか！？」
pages.jaRuby:
「ま、待ってくださいシロウ、話はまったく、一手たりとも進んでいません！
朝食を十分に摂ったから昼食はいらない、というのはあまりに浅慮ではありませんか！？」
pages.en:
“W-wait, Shirou! This conversation has not advanced by so much as a single move!

“Is it not extraordinarily shortsighted to decide that because you ate a substantial breakfast, you require no lunch!?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“H-Hold on Shirou. Our conversation has not finished!
Is it not thoughtless to suppose that we do not need lunch because we had enough breakfast!?”

pages.ja:
「え、うわ……！ な、なにすんだよセイバー！ 竹刀返せ！」
「返せませんっ。もう時間がない、私はサーヴァントとしてマスターに速やかな食事の準備を要求します……！」
pages.jaRuby:
「え、うわ……！ な、なにすんだよセイバー！ 竹刀返せ！」
「返せませんっ。もう時間がない、私はサーヴァントとしてマスターに速やかな食事の準備を要求します……！」
pages.en:
“What—whoa…! What are you doing, Saber? Give back my shinai!”

“I cannot. Time is already short. As a Servant, I demand that my Master prepare food without delay…!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Whoa…! W-What are you doing, Saber!?
Give me back my shinai!”
“No. We do not have time. As a Servant, I demand my Master prepare some food quickly…!”

pages.ja:
「………………」
……ちょっと待て。
幾らなんでもセイバーのヤツ、おかしすぎるぞ？
pages.jaRuby:
「………………」
……ちょっと待て。
幾らなんでもセイバーのヤツ、おかしすぎるぞ？
pages.en:
“………………”

…Wait.

Even by Saber's standards, this is much too strange.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
…Hold on.
Saber is acting too strangely.

pages.ja:
「セイバー。時間がないって、何か予定でもあるのか？」
「特にありません。ですから昼食にしましょう、と言っているのです」
「いや。だから昼食は抜きにするって」
pages.jaRuby:
「セイバー。時間がないって、何か予定でもあるのか？」
「特にありません。ですから昼食にしましょう、と言っているのです」
「いや。だから昼食は抜きにするって」
pages.en:
“Saber. You keep saying there's no time. Do you have plans?”

“None. That is why I am telling you we should have lunch.”

“But I just said we're skipping it.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Saber. Are you in a hurry? Do you have something to do?”
“No. I am telling you that we should have lunch.”
“No. I say we’re skipping lunch.”

pages.ja:
「バカな、これだけ言っても分からないのですかっ……！
これが最後ですシロウ、今すぐ昼食にしてください！」
pages.jaRuby:
「バカな、これだけ言っても分からないのですかっ……！
これが最後ですシロウ、今すぐ昼食にしてください！」
pages.en:
“Foolishness! Must you remain ignorant after everything I have said…!?

“This is your final warning, Shirou. Serve lunch immediately!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ridiculous, you do not understand even now…!?
This is your final warning, Shirou. Please make lunch right now!”

pages.ja:
「う、っ
？」
掴みかからんばかりの迫力で抗議するセイバー。
その、あまりにも不自然な言動に思わず頷きそうになった時。
pages.jaRuby:
「う、っ
？」
掴みかからんばかりの迫力で抗議するセイバー。
その、あまりにも不自然な言動に思わず頷きそうになった時。
pages.en:
“Ngh——?”

Saber protests with such force that she seems on the verge of seizing me by the collar.

I am about to yield before the sheer unnaturalness of her behavior when——
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Uh?”
Saber protests with enough force that I think she might come at me.
And right when I’m about to nod because of her strange actions…

pages.ja:
「あ、腹の虫」
きゅるる、とセイバーのおなかが空腹を訴えた。
pages.jaRuby:
「あ、腹の虫」
きゅるる、とセイバーのおなかが空腹を訴えた。
pages.en:
“Oh. Your stomach.”

With a plaintive gurgle, Saber's stomach announces its hunger.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, your stomach.”
Saber’s stomach complains of hunger.

pages.ja:
「いまのセイバー？ なに、そんなにお腹減ってたの？」
「い、いえ、とくに空腹は感じていないのですが、体は栄養を必要としているようです」
pages.jaRuby:
「いまのセイバー？ なに、そんなにお腹減ってたの？」
「い、いえ、とくに空腹は感じていないのですが、体は栄養を必要としているようです」
pages.en:
“Was that Saber? Were you truly that hungry?”

“N-no. I feel no particular hunger, but it appears my body requires nourishment.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Was that you, Saber? Are you that hungry?”
“N-No, I am not that hungry, but it seems my body wants energy.”

pages.ja: 「ふーん……ずっと動いてたから仕方ないかもしれないけど、はしたないわよセイバー？ サーヴァントだからって嗜みを忘れてたら、シロウに嫌われちゃうんだから」
pages.jaRuby: 「ふーん……ずっと動いてたから仕方ないかもしれないけど、はしたないわよセイバー？ サーヴァントだからって嗜みを忘れてたら、シロウに嫌われちゃうんだから」
pages.en: “Hm… You have been moving constantly, so I suppose it was bound to happen. But it isn't very ladylike, Saber. If you forget your manners merely because you're a Servant, Shirou won't like you anymore.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Oh… I guess it can’t be helped since you were moving around all this time, but it’s a bit vulgar, Saber. If you forget modesty just because you’re a Servant, Shirou won’t like you.”

pages.ja: 「そ、そのようなコトはありませんっ！ わたしはサーヴァントなのですから、シロウが落胆する事柄はわたしの敗北だけですっ！」
pages.jaRuby: 「そ、そのようなコトはありませんっ！ わたしはサーヴァントなのですから、シロウが落胆する事柄はわたしの敗北だけですっ！」
pages.en: “Th-that is not true! I am his Servant. The only thing I could do to disappoint Shirou is suffer defeat!”
pages.mirrorMoon: “T-That is not true! I am a Servant, so the only thing that would dismay Shirou would be my defeat!”

pages.ja: 「えっと……別に負けたからガッカリするとかしないし、負けなければ何しても驚かないってワケじゃないぞ、セイバー」
pages.jaRuby: 「えっと……別に負けたからガッカリするとかしないし、負けなければ何しても驚かないってワケじゃないぞ、セイバー」
pages.en: “Um… I wouldn't be disappointed simply because you lost. And winning every battle doesn't mean nothing else you do can surprise me, Saber.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Um… I won’t be dismayed if you lose, and that doesn’t mean I won’t be surprised by anything other than your defeat.”

pages.ja:
「そ・れ・だ・け・です！ だいたい、空腹時に腹部が鳴るのは正しい身体機能です！ それが気に障るというのでしたら、私に食事を与えないシロウが悪いっ」
イリヤを睨み、ついで、セイバー曰く一番悪い俺が睨まれた。
pages.jaRuby:
「そ・れ・だ・け・です！ だいたい、空腹時に腹部が鳴るのは正しい身体機能です！ それが気に障るというのでしたら、私に食事を与えないシロウが悪いっ」
イリヤを睨み、ついで、セイバー曰く一番悪い俺が睨まれた。
pages.en:
“That. Is. All! Furthermore, a stomach sounding when empty is a perfectly proper bodily function! If it displeases you, then Shirou is at fault for refusing to feed me!”

Saber glares first at Illya, then at me, whom she has identified as the greatest offender.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That-is-the-only-reason!! First of all, it is an appropriate function for a stomach to growl when hungry! If that annoys you, it is Shirou’s fault for not letting me eat!”
She glares at Illya and then at me, who, according to her, is the cause of this.

pages.ja:
ちなみに、腹の虫は飢餓収縮と呼ばれる胃腸の動きが原因である。
胃はたえず伸縮しているのだが、空腹時にはこの運動が激しくなる。で、胃の収縮によって内部にたまっていた空気が圧縮され、唸るような音が響くワケなのだ。
……で、逆説的ではあるが、腹の虫は自律神経の影響も受けている。
pages.jaRuby:
ちなみに、腹の虫は飢餓収縮と呼ばれる胃腸の動きが原因である。
胃はたえず伸縮しているのだが、空腹時にはこの運動が激しくなる。で、胃の収縮によって内部にたまっていた空気が圧縮され、唸るような音が響くワケなのだ。
……で、逆説的ではあるが、腹の虫は自律神経の影響も受けている。
pages.en:
For reference, the sound of a hungry stomach is caused by gastrointestinal movement known as hunger contractions.

The stomach contracts continually, but the motion grows more vigorous when empty. The contractions compress the air trapped inside, producing the familiar growling sound.

…Paradoxically, however, the autonomic nervous system apparently also influences this phenomenon.
pages.mirrorMoon:
By the way, the growling of the stomach is caused by movements of stomach called hunger contraction.
The stomach is always expanding and contracting, but this movement is stronger during hunger. And with the contraction of the stomach, the air inside the stomach is compressed and a growling sound is made.
…And it’s kind of paradoxical, but the growling is affected by the autonomic nervous system as well.

pages.ja:
そもそも胃の運動は絶えず行われているワケであって、空腹時にしか鳴らない、なんてコトはない。
胃の運動……音を大きく鳴らす原因は、
“お腹が減った、音が鳴りそうだ、鳴ったら空腹だと知られてしまう、だから我慢しないと”
なんて、自分で緊張を高めてしまい、余計に胃を激しく運動させてしまうからだとか。
pages.jaRuby:
そもそも胃の運動は絶えず行われているワケであって、空腹時にしか鳴らない、なんてコトはない。
胃の運動……音を大きく鳴らす原因は、
“お腹が減った、音が鳴りそうだ、鳴ったら空腹だと知られてしまう、だから我慢しないと”
なんて、自分で緊張を高めてしまい、余計に胃を激しく運動させてしまうからだとか。
pages.en:
The stomach moves constantly. It does not sound only when a person is hungry.

What intensifies the motion—and thereby the noise—is apparently the tension one creates by thinking:

“I'm hungry. My stomach is going to make a noise. If it does, everyone will know. I must prevent it.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
After all, the stomach is always active and it’s not true that it growls only when one’s hungry.
The motion of the stomach… the reason for the loud sound is…
‘I’m hungry. If it growls people would know I’m hungry, so I have to hold it’
…Tensing yourself up and making your stomach all the more active, or something like that.

ふむ。
つまり、要するに。
pages.jaRuby:
ふむ。
つまり、要するに。
pages.en:
——Hm.

In other words——
pages.mirrorMoon:
Hmm.
So, in other words.

pages.ja:
「ははーん。さてはセイバー、ハラ減ってるんで気が立ってるんだな？ イライラしてんのはそのせいか。まったく、朝あんなに食べてたのに燃費悪いぞ」
「なっ」
pages.jaRuby:
「ははーん。さてはセイバー、ハラ減ってるんで気が立ってるんだな？ イライラしてんのはそのせいか。まったく、朝あんなに食べてたのに燃費悪いぞ」
「なっ」
pages.en:
“Aha. I see it now, Saber. You're irritable because you're hungry. That explains why you've been snapping at everyone. Honestly, you ate so much this morning. Your fuel economy is terrible.”

“What——”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ohhh. Could it be that you’re angry because you’re hungry? So that’s why you’re irritated? Geez, your energy consumption is pretty high considering how much you ate this morning.”
“Wha-”

pages.ja: 「ふーん。そういえば、静かだから目立たなかったけどリンの二倍は食べてたよね。セイバーって食いしん坊だったんだ」
pages.jaRuby: 「ふーん。そういえば、静かだから目立たなかったけどリンの二倍は食べてたよね。セイバーって食いしん坊だったんだ」
pages.en: “Hm. Now that I think about it, you ate twice as much as Rin. I didn't notice because you were so quiet. Saber is a glutton.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Oh. Come to think of it, it wasn’t that obvious because she was quiet, but she was eating twice as much as Rin. Saber is such a glutton.”

pages.ja:
「それは違う、私が大食漢なのではなくリンが小食なのです！ シロウだって判って
」
pages.jaRuby:
「それは違う、私が大食漢なのではなくリンが小食なのです！ シロウだって判って
」
pages.en: “That is false! I am not a great eater; Rin eats too little! Shirou understands——”
pages.mirrorMoon: “That is wrong. I am not a huge eater, but it is rather that Rin is a small eater! Shirou should understand that t”

pages.ja:
「んー、そうみたいだな。セイバー、ほっといたら最後までごはん食べてるし。本気になったら藤ねえと同じぐらい食べるんじゃないか？」
「そのようなコトはありませんっ！ いったい何を見ていたのですかシロウは！」
pages.jaRuby:
「んー、そうみたいだな。セイバー、ほっといたら最後までごはん食べてるし。本気になったら藤ねえと同じぐらい食べるんじゃないか？」
「そのようなコトはありませんっ！ いったい何を見ていたのですかシロウは！」
pages.en:
“Mm. I suppose you do eat until the very end if no one stops you. If you really applied yourself, you might eat as much as Fuji.”

“Nothing of the kind! What have you been watching all this time, Shirou!?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hmm, it seems that way. Saber always finishes her meal. If we let her, maybe she’d eat as much as Fuji-nee.”
“That is not true! What were you watching, Shirou!?”

pages.ja:
「え……？ いや、素直な感想なんだが。
それにほら、いつもこの時間になるとハラの虫鳴らしてるじゃんか。食いしん坊かどうかは別にして、セイバー、お腹減るの早いと思うぞ？」

」

pages.jaRuby:

」

pages.en:
“What…? I was only giving my honest impression.

“Besides, your stomach growls around this time every day. Glutton or not, you seem to become hungry rather quickly.”

“————————”

“See? I knew it. How unladylike of you, Saber.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Huh…? Well, it’s just an honest opinion.
And your stomach always growls at this time of the day. Leaving the matter of gluttony aside, I think you get hungry pretty fast.”
“”
“See. Saber is so unladylike!”

pages.ja: セイバーを遣り込めたのが嬉しいのか、イリヤは嬉しそうに飛び跳ねる。
pages.jaRuby: セイバーを遣り込めたのが嬉しいのか、イリヤは嬉しそうに飛び跳ねる。
pages.en: Delighted to have bested Saber, Illya begins hopping with joy.
pages.mirrorMoon: She must be happy that she was able to disparage Saber as she jumps for joy.

pages.ja:
一方、さっきまで珍しく取り乱していたセイバーは
何事もなかったように、いつものセイバーに戻っていた。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Meanwhile, Saber, who until moments ago had been uncharacteristically agitated——

——outwardly returns to her usual composure as though nothing at all has happened.
pages.mirrorMoon:
On the other hand, Saber, who was in a rare panic earlier, is
back to her usual self as if nothing has happened.

体力

pages.en:
“…Saber? Um, aren't you angry?”

“I am not angry. Illyasviel is correct that I consume a great deal of food.

“Perhaps I have been forcing myself to accumulate as much physical strength—no, as much magical energy—as possible, so that I might lessen the burden upon Shirou.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Saber? Um, you’re not mad, are you?”
“I am not mad. As Illyasviel says, I am taking in a lot of food.
I might have been pushing myself to reduce Shirou’s burden by taking in as much energyno, as much magical energy as possible.”

pages.ja:
「あ
」
……そうか。
セイバーは自分で魔力を補充するしかない。
睡眠をとる事で魔力消費を抑え、
食事をとる事で少しでも活力を蓄えておきたかったのだろう。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Ah——”

…Of course.

Saber has no choice but to replenish her magical energy herself.

She reduces its consumption through sleep and tries to gather whatever vitality she can through food.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh”
…Oh yeah.
Saber can only replenish magical energy by herself.
She must have wanted to save her magical energy by sleeping,
and she must have wanted to retain her energy by eating.

“…I'm sorry. I didn't think.

“Of course. If her Master cannot replenish her magical energy, Saber has no choice but to conserve it herself.

“Even though we've established a connection, that doesn't mean we have energy to spare.”

サーヴァントは存在しているだけで大量の魔力を消費する。
しかし、セイバーが一日で作れる魔力は、一日の存在に必要な量に満たないのだ。

pages.en:
She needs many times more magical energy than I possess.

A Servant consumes an enormous quantity merely by remaining in this world.

Yet the energy Saber can produce in one day falls short of what she needs to exist for a single day.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Many times more than the magical energy I have, too.
Servants use up huge amounts of magical energy just by existing.
But Saber can only create enough magical energy to keep herself alive.

“That is unnecessary. You have declared that you prefer this.”

恐る恐る声をかける。

恐る恐る声をかける。
pages.en:
“Wait. Please wait. Let's calm down.

“…Saber, you're actually furious, aren't you?”

I address her with all possible caution.

“Hold on, hold on, let’s calm down.
…Saber, you’re actually really mad, right?”
I ask her timidly.

“Now then. We shall proceed lightly, as always.”

こっちの言い分なんて聞きやしない。
稲妻のような衝撃。

She pays no attention to my protest.

An impact like lightning.

Freed from the restraint imposed by her role as my instructor, Saber bares her fangs without the slightest mercy.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She won’t listen to me.
An impact like lightning.
With her shackles as my teacher released, Saber attacks me violently.

pages.ja:
はい、こんにちはー！
ちょっとした手違いで命を終えた貴方を昇天させる心霊ワールド、タイガー道場でーす！
助手の死後の天使一号でーす。
しっかし、人生注意一秒怪我一生。
冗談の通じない相手をからかう時は、死を覚悟してからかうべきなんですねぇ。
そうみたいね。けどシロウ、セイバーの一突きで魂吐き出すなんて可愛いんだから、もう。
……美的感覚が壊れたちびっ子……。
と、それはいいとして、今回のホトケさんはわりかしキレイよねー。原形残ってるなんて珍しいんじゃない？
そうね。なんか物足りない感じ。
…………いじるか？
…………いじろっか？
よし、これより改造手術を行う！ 何かの手違いで蘇らないように、まずは両手をガトリング砲に改造するのだ！
サー、イエッサー！
よし、インスタントにオペ終了！
どうかね！ 全身を改造された気分は！
だが君の意思を尊重し、最後の改造、脳手術は止めておいた！
おいた！
さあ、このまま自主的に我ら虎ッカーの一員となるか、洗脳されてマシンとなるか！ 君の意思で決めたまえ！
た、たいへんです総統！ 実験体が改造されたパワーを使って、拘束を引き千切りました！
きゃー、おお暴れです！ 基地が破壊されます！
わ、我々は自らの手で最強の敵を生んでしまったのではないでしょーか！

pages.en:
Hello, everyone!

Welcome to the Tiger Dojo, the spirit world where we guide into heaven those whose lives ended through minor misunderstandings!

I'm your assistant, Posthumous Angel Number One!

A second of carelessness, a lifetime of injury.

Apparently, when teasing someone incapable of taking a joke, one should first prepare to die.

So it seems. But Shirou, coughing up your soul after one little thrust from Saber was almost adorable.

…A small child with a broken sense of beauty…

Never mind that. This episode's corpse is unusually tidy, isn't it? Having one arrive with its original shape intact is quite rare.

It does feel a little disappointing.

…………Shall we tamper with it?

…………Let's tamper with it.

Excellent! We shall now perform conversion surgery! To ensure the subject cannot return to life through some unfortunate mistake, we shall begin by replacing both hands with Gatling guns!

Sir, yes, sir!

Excellent! The operation is instantly complete!

How does it feel to have your entire body remodeled?

In deference to your wishes, however, we omitted the final procedure: brain surgery!

We omitted it!

Now you may either volunteer to join our glorious Tiger-Shocker organization, or submit to brainwashing and become our machine! Choose freely!

S-Supreme Leader! The test subject has used the strength of his remodeled body to tear free of his restraints!

Ahhh! He's running wild! He'll destroy the base!

C-could we have created the ultimate enemy with our own hands!?
pages.mirrorMoon:
Hello!
This is the spiritual world that takes you to heaven, congratulating you for dying from a small mistake, the Tiger Dojo!
I am the assistant, dead angel number 1.
But in life, you should take simple precautions or the wounds will last forever.
If you’re about to make fun of someone who doesn’t get jokes, I guess you have to be prepared to die.
I guess so. But Shirou is really cute, spitting his soul out after just one thrust from Saber.
…This kid has a messed up sense of aesthetics…
Though, this corpse is rather beautiful. Isn’t it rare for him to keep his form?
Yeah, it really isn’t enough.
…Should we mess with it?
…Shall we mess with it?
All right, we’ll start the modding operation! First, we’ll modify his hands into gatling guns so he won’t revive from some mistake!
Sir, yes sir!
All right, operation finished instantaneously!
What do you think!? How does it feel to have your whole body transformed!?
But we have respected your will and we have not performed the last transformation, the brain surgery!
We didn’t!
Now, choose whether you will become one of us, the Tigers, by your own will, or if you will choose brainwashing and become a machine! Choose with your own will!
T-This is bad, master! The experiment used its transformed powers to rip off the restraints!
Kyaa! He’s going on a rampage! Our base will be destroyed!
W-We might have created our own nemesis!

pages.en:
“You have awakened, Shirou. Failing to evade the opening strike was disgraceful.

“Now evade the next one properly. I am restricting myself to the forms of kendo, so if you fight as though your life depends upon it, you may endure for a short while.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Have you awoken, Shirou? I am ashamed that you could not even dodge the first blow.
So please dodge it next time. I am using kendo techniques, so you should be able to survive it for a little while if you become desperate.”

ぱあーん、と炸裂するセイバー怒りの竹刀。

“What…!? Y-you still intend to keep going!?”

“Naturally. Ten minutes remain until lunch. As always, we shall continue until you reach your limit.”

Saber's furious shinai explodes against me.

“…! W-W-What… are we still going to continue!?”
“Of course. There are ten more minutes until we
usually
have lunch. Let us train our hearts out as usual.”
Saber’s shinai of anger strikes again.

う」

う」

“Ah—ugh.”

Once more, my consciousness begins to fade.

…I must remember this.

When angered, Saber repays an offense to the bitter end…
